text:
Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and even making decisions. 

A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. By analyzing large amounts of information, they improve their performance over time. A more advanced type is deep learning, which mimics the human brain’s structure using artificial neural networks to handle very complex patterns.

You likely use AI every day without noticing. It helps recommend movies on streaming services, powers voice assistants like Siri or Alexa, filters spam from your email, and even assists doctors in reading medical scans. As AI continues to develop, its role in our daily lives is only set to grow.
